incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A severely damaged brick building with collapsed sections and rubble on the street, featuring a traffic light and construction cones. Modern buildings are visible in the background.

observations.description: The upper floors of a brick building are collapsed and exposed, with debris scattered on the ground.
A traffic light and a lamppost are present on the street corner.
A white vehicle is parked in the distance on the street.
A pile of bricks and rubble is on the street, with an orange traffic cone and a sign that says 'No S' visible.
Trees are visible in the distance behind buildings.
A large, ornate building with a spire is in the background.
